Extract Metadata Elements from Data Packages

Source: R/extract_metadata.R
extract_metadata.Rd

Extracts specified metadata elements from one or more Camera Trap Data Packages (camtrap DP) and returns them as tidy data frames. Handles flexible list structures and automatically replaces NULL values with NA to ensure consistent data types.

Usage

extract_metadata(
  dp_list,
  elements = c("contributors", "sources", "licenses", "relatedIdentifiers", "references",
    "project", "WildObsMetadata", "spatial", "temporal", "taxonomic")
)

Arguments

dp_list

A single data package (list) or a list of data packages to extract metadata from. Each data package should be a named list with an id field.

elements

A character vector specifying which metadata elements to extract. Supported elements are: "contributors", "sources", "licenses", "relatedIdentifiers", "references", "project", "WildObsMetadata", "spatial", "temporal", "taxonomic".

Value

If a single element is requested: A data frame with one row per record (or one row for flat objects) and columns for each field in that element. Includes a DPID column with the source data package ID.

If multiple elements are requested: A named list of data frames, one for each requested element. Each data frame includes a DPID column to distinguish different data packages

When multiple data packages are provided, results are accumulated across all DPs using dplyr::bind_rows(), so each data frame in the result contains records from all input data packages.

Details

This function is designed for extracting and standardizing metadata from camtrap DP packages. It handles:

  • Single or multiple data packages

  • Flexible list structures (lists of objects vs. flat objects)

  • NULL values (replaced with NA for consistency)

  • Multiple data packages (rows combined via dplyr::bind_rows())

Spatial data

The "spatial" element returns a dataframe of bounding box coordinates (locationName, xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) for convenient inspection. Users who need the full GeoJSON geometry for spatial analysis or mapping can access it directly via dp$spatial and convert it to an sf object with geojsonsf::geojson_sf(jsonlite::toJSON(dp$spatial, auto_unbox = TRUE)).

Temporal data

The "temporal" element returns one row per deploymentGroup, with columns deploymentGroup, start, end, timeZone, packageStart, packageEnd and DPID. packageStart and packageEnd hold the package-level temporal extent that Camtrap DP requires, repeated on every row, and are NA for packages that do not carry it. A package with no deploymentGroup blocks returns a single row with deploymentGroup = NA. Packages saved by earlier WildObsR versions, which stored timeZone inside each deploymentGroup, are still read correctly.

Author

Zachary Amir

Examples

# the two Wet Tropics projects shipped with WildObsR
dp_list <- example_datapackages()

# one element, as a table with a row per contributor per project
contributors <- extract_metadata(dp_list, "contributors")
contributors[, c("title", "role", "DPID")]
#>            title                  role
#> 1   Zachary Amir principalInvestigator
#> 2      Tom Bruce               contact
#> 3 Matthew Luskin          rightsHolder
#> 4   Grant Linley principalInvestigator
#> 5    Chris Jolly           contributor
#> 6 Emma E Spencer           contributor
#>                                                   DPID
#> 1            ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001
#> 2            ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001
#> 3            ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001
#> 4 NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010
#> 5 NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010
#> 6 NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010

# several elements at once, as a named list of tables
meta <- extract_metadata(dp_list, c("licenses", "project"))
meta$licenses
#>        name                                         path scope
#> 1 CC-BY-4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/  data
#> 2 CC-BY-4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ media
#> 3 CC-BY-4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/  data
#> 4 CC-BY-4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ media
#>                                                   DPID
#> 1            ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001
#> 2            ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001
#> 3 NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010
#> 4 NSW_Woomargama_wombats_Linley_2021-22_WildObsID_0010

# a single package works too
extract_metadata(dp_list[[1]], "WildObsMetadata")
#>   thinnedMedia deploymentClusters               fundingAgency
#> 1        false               true federalGovernment; ngoGrant
#>   tabularSharingPreference desiredOutputs groupSizes
#> 1                     open     everything       true
#>                                        DPID embargoPeriodMonths
#> 1 ZAmir_QLD_Wet_Tropics_2022_WildObsID_0001                   0
#>     WildObsContribution          deploymentTags
#> 1 dingo-cat-fox project bait;predatorManagement
